finding: A format is only a label today. Naming it changes nothing in production: what differs comes from what the brief happens to contain. Step-by-step recipes are written for 4 formats and connected to the engine for none. The word format lives in 5 lists that disagree (12, 20, 14 with 31 variants, 13 owner calls, 2 caption picks).

definition.source: Owner rulings 2026-09-11 (avatar, sub-avatar, angle and format are four things; format = how it is built) and 2026-11-02 (a video names a script format and a production format; production has one line per execution type). The sort of bank rows into script and production is a draft and the owner's to correct.
definition.what:
**A format is how the ad is built.** It is two choices, and every ad names both.
**Script format: what it says.** The shape of the argument. Writing reads it.
**Production format: how it is made.** What is on screen and what carries the sound. Production and the edit read it, and each one is its own production line.
**It is not** the avatar (who), the angle (what we claim), the style (the look) or the maker (AI, creator, founder). Any of those pairs with any format.
_From your rulings of 11 Sep and 2 Nov._
definition.lists:
**Script formats in the bank (7):** remedy · demonstration · expert consultation · testimonial montage · meme · micro-drama · comedy skit
**Production formats in the bank (3):** single presenter · song ad · text thread
**Not sorted yet (2), your call:** narrator montage (reads as production) · ad series (reads as neither: a run of ads, each with its own format)
**Production recipes written outside the bank (8):** multi-speaker scene · short movie · voiceover explainer · sports interview · talking object · freestyle battle · two stunt recipes
definition.example:
**Example: one idea, two ads**
**Script format:** remedy. What people used to put on it at home, then today's version.
**× single presenter:** one person to camera. Voice first, then talking clips. Captions at the bottom.
**× song ad:** the same argument as lyric lines. Song first, then a clip per line. Lyric captions.
Same avatar, same angle, same script format. Only the production line changes.
_Today a run holds one name, so this pairing cannot be written down._
definition.carry:
**How it carries through: today → needed**
**Teardown:** reads one format off the swipe → reads both, against one list.
**Writing:** gets the format as a paragraph of text → the script format sets the argument; the production format sets which kinds of scene it may write.
**Production:** stamps the name and does the same thing whatever it is → the production format picks the line and its stations.
**Edit:** has a caption pick for 2 formats → the production format picks the road, the caption look and the pace.
**Results:** score the ad → score script × production, so the numbers say which pairing earns.
definition.system:
**In the system: three changes**
**1** Every run carries two names, not one.
**2** One list holds both kinds; the other four lists read from it.
**3** Each production format's recipe drives the engine instead of sitting beside it.
